content.short: Market Makers is an epic NFT collection by Storm Trade providing exclusive bonuses for the Storm ecosystem.
content.description: Market Makers is a premier NFT collection launched by the Storm Trade team, featuring 5,555 unique pieces that represent the 'Bulls, Bears, and Birds' of the financial world. Holding a Market Makers NFT provides users with significant utility and exclusive benefits within the Storm Trade decentralized derivatives ecosystem, including trading fee discounts, early access to new features, and priority whitelist status for future drops. It is a key asset for active participants in the TON DeFi landscape, blending high-quality digital art with robust platform-specific utility.
